data.body_html:
When you're planning a day on the water in Marbella, two names often come up: the Pershing 46 and the Sunseeker Predator 55. Both are sporty, stylish, and turn heads in Puerto Banús. But they're very different boats. This 2043 comparison breaks down the specs, performance, and real-world charter experience to help you decide which suits your group, budget, and vibe.

Specs at a glance

FeaturePershing 46Sunseeker Predator 55
Length14m17.4m
Beam4.2m4.6m
Passengers1010
Engines2× 800hp2× 800hp (typical)
Top speed~45 knots~35 knots
DeparturePuerto BanúsPuerto Banús (not in our fleet)

We don't currently offer the Sunseeker Predator 55, but we do offer the Pershing 46 and the similar-sized Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) for comparison.

Performance: speed vs comfort

The Pershing 46 is a thoroughbred. With twin 800hp engines, it planes quickly and cruises at 40 knots without breaking a sweat. You'll feel the acceleration in your stomach as you leave Puerto Banús behind. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is no slouch, but it's built more for cruising comfort. Its deeper V-hull and heavier displacement mean a softer ride in choppy seas, but you'll trade top-end speed.

For a 2-hour blast to Cala del Faro and back, the Pershing 46 is the clear winner. For a full-day cruise down to Estepona or Sotogrande, the Predator's stability pays off.

Deck layout and onboard experience

The Pershing 46 has a sporty, low-profile cockpit with a large sunpad aft and a well-protected helm. It's intimate — perfect for 4–6 people. The Predator 55, being 3.4m longer, offers a more expansive cockpit with a wet bar, L-shaped seating, and a bigger swim platform. You can spread out more, and the higher freeboard gives a sense of security.

If you're planning to anchor and swim, the Pershing 46's swim platform is closer to the water, making entry easier. The Predator's platform is larger but higher. Both have showers and ladders.

Chartering in Marbella: what to expect

All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury scene. You'll meet your skipper at the marina, board, and be underway within 10 minutes. The skipper knows the best spots: Cala Cortés for a quiet swim, Cabopino for a beach lunch, or the iconic Marbella skyline with La Concha behind.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs — you just choose your route and relax.

Price comparison and value

The Pershing 46 is a premium sport yacht, so its charter rate is higher than our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, which cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours). For the Pershing 46, pricing is on request via WhatsApp — expect a premium for the performance and brand cachet.

The Sunseeker Predator 55, if available, would likely sit in a similar or higher price bracket. But since we don't have one, we recommend the Azimut 58 for a comparable experience at a more accessible price. For a truly grand day out, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski.

Who should choose which?

Choose the Pershing 46 if:

  • You want adrenaline and speed
  • Your group is 6 or fewer
  • You're celebrating something special and want a head-turning boat

Choose the Sunseeker Predator 55 (or our Azimut 58) if:

  • You prefer space and stability over speed
  • You have children or older guests
  • You plan to spend most of the day anchored and swimming

Our 2043 recommendation

For most Marbella day charters, we'd steer you toward the Pershing 46 if you're after a sporty, memorable experience. It's fast, beautiful, and perfectly suited to a 2–4 hour trip to Cala del Faro and back. If you're set on a larger, more comfortable yacht, skip the Predator 55 (which we don't have) and book the Azimut 58 Flybridge instead — it's 17.6m, holds 12 guests, and offers a flybridge for panoramic views of the Costa del Sol.

Ready to book? Browse our full fleet and send us a WhatsApp message for availability on the Pershing 46 or any other boat. We'll get back to you within the hour with a personalised quote.

For a group of 8–10, the Predator's extra length pays off. For a couple or small group, the Pershing 46 is a thrill.
